metric_notes.comparison_differences: The first named condition minus the second.
metric_notes.evaluation_job_success_rate_percent: Distribution across checkpoint-by-unit-count evaluation jobs; use its standard deviation as run-level variability only within one unit-count group.
metric_notes.never_connected_unit: A unit with zero successful connector activations during the episode. All evaluated episodes start fully disconnected.
metric_notes.pooled_statistics: Means and population standard deviations pool the source first and second moments using their exact episode or episode-unit observation counts.
